name: budget-app-electron
description: Money Weather - Budget App Electron Wrapper
author: Monroe Engineering

nsis._comment_oneClick: FALSE = wizard mode (shows progress + finish page). TRUE = silent self-extractor (no UI). Must be FALSE so the Run checkbox appears.
nsis._comment_allowToChangeInstallationDirect: FALSE = no directory page; installer reuses previous path from uninstall registry.
nsis._comment_perMachine: FALSE = defaults to per-user; the install-mode page is skipped by installer.nsh setting $MultiUser.InstallMode.
nsis._comment_runAfterFinish: TRUE = finish page shows checked 'Run Money Weather' checkbox. Must stay TRUE.
nsis._comment_include: installer.nsh sets $MultiUser.InstallMode to skip the install-mode page during updates. DO NOT REMOVE.
